beforeDescriptions.descriptionHtml:
Preserve your little one's earliest days with a customised baby photo frame from Cartwala. Upload your favourite baby photo and we'll print it on premium matte-finish paper, ready to hang the moment it arrives.

A lovely keepsake for baby showers, first birthdays, or new-parent gifting — designed and printed by Cartwala for delivery across India.

Personalized Baby Birth Frame

Make a favourite memory part of everyday life with the Cartwala Baby Birth Frame. This personalised design is a thoughtful choice for baby & milestones gifting and displaying your photographs.

  • Design: Baby Birth Frame.
  • Personalisation: your photos, with names or a short message where the shown layout includes text.
  • Choose from 10 sizes: 4x6, 5x7, 6x8, 8x10, 8x12, 10x15, 12x18, 16x24, 20x30 and 24x36 inches.
  • Package: one personalised frame in the selected size.

How to personalise

Choose your size and place your order. Send clear original photos and the required text to Cartwala on WhatsApp at +91 9948286705 with your order number. Check names and dates before sending.

Images illustrate the design with sample personalisation. Layout and photo cropping are adapted to the selected dimensions. Colours may vary slightly between screen and print.
